entities.summary: Shah Ahmad Noorani Siddiqi was a Pakistani Islamic scholar and politician. He was the founder and first president of the Muttahida Majlis-e-Amal (MMA) from 2002 until his death in 2003. He served as the president of Jamiat Ulema-e-Pakistan (JUP) from the 1970s until his death.
